title: `description`
description: The natural-language description an MCP server publishes to explain what a tool does.
question: Is the full tool description present at each capture boundary?
notes: Four frameworks pass the description through byte for byte. One rewrites it into a longer template.

notes_by_num.1: CrewAI: the captured description is rebuilt as `Tool Name: ... Tool Arguments: {schema} Tool Description: ...`, duplicating the schema as prose and parameters.

verdict.headline: Verbatim in four frameworks, rewritten in one.
verdict.detail: One framework rebuilds the description to include the tool name and the full argument schema.

usage_note: Not published. Candidate source: count of public MCP servers using this capability. Not estimated, so the panel stays empty until the corpus is scanned.

after: Tool Description: Search records with optional filters."

why: If passed downstream, injected text spends context tokens and can steer a model in ways the tool author did not write.
reproduce: uv run mcp-mirror scan "uv run python fixtures/tricky_server.py" --runner managed --frameworks crewai,langchain,openai_agents,pydantic_ai --spec-version 2025-11-25 --job J4
